_comment: Crew (player-faction) cards, transcribed from the card images at https://www.hf4map.com/cards/crew/ . Six double-faced physical cards (card0..card5), two factions each = 12. Crews have NO spectral type. Each face: promotion letter (the (X) on the card), mass, radHardness, isru value + prospector kind (buggy/raygun), an optional thruster { name, thrustMN, specImp ks (flavour), gameThrust (the number in the bottom-left thrust triangle), dirt (true for the gray dirt-thruster triangle - NASRDA / Norse) }; thruster is null when the card shows a lander instead (Shimizu). bottomBadges = the magenta + blue circle numbers at the card foot (meaning TBD). privilege = title + effect. NOTE: the dirt-thruster triangle number was not legible in the image; gameThrust 2 for those is inferred from the (identically sized) triangle. data/crew.js mirrors this for the browser; keep them in sync.

privilege.title: SECRETARY GENERAL
privilege.effect: Start with +2 Aqua. (Module 2: after 1st anchor of your Home Bernal.)

privilege.title: BLINK TELESCOPE
privilege.effect: 1 re-roll per prospecting operation when using a Raygun.

privilege.title: TAXES
privilege.effect: +1 Aqua from the Pool after any player places a Claim or industrializes a Claim.

privilege.title: FELONIOUS
privilege.effect: Your Humans may perform Felonious actions. Negotiable.

privilege.title: LAUNCH FEES
privilege.effect: +1 Aqua from the Pool after any player performs a boost operation.

privilege.title: DHARMA REFUEL
privilege.effect: If any of your Humans carry a glory chit, double yield from a Colocated site refuel operation.

privilege.title: OPEN SOURCE FINAO
privilege.effect: Failure Is Not An Option costs 3 Aqua.

privilege.title: POWERSAT
privilege.effect: During any player's Turn, may give +1 thrust to any Spacecraft that has a push icon in its thruster triangle. Negotiable.

privilege.title: SKUNKWORKS
privilege.effect: Ignore academia hand limit when bidding or starting an auction.

privilege.title: MOONCABLE
privilege.effect: Once-per-turn free action: refuel an activated dirt thrust triangle at LEO/Home Bernal with 7 tanks (non-crew thruster) or 1 tank (Crew thruster). Negotiable. An activated dirt thruster can accept 1 tank of dirt max per Turn.

privilege.title: MARKETEER
privilege.effect: If you make the highest bid in an auction, you win even if tied.

privilege.title: SCRUM TROUBLESHOOTERS
privilege.effect: You may perform Glitch repair anywhere (even without Humans present). Negotiable. An activated dirt thruster can accept 1 tank of dirt max per Turn.
